Name: Build Endurance
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Level up your endurance to increase your max stamina as you play.

[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 3.0 or later.[/color][/b]


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
To undo the mod's changes later, edit the [font=Courier New]data\*.json[/font] file for your save and change the [font=Courier New]ClearModEffects[/font] field to [font=Courier New]true[/font].

[size=5]Usage[/size]
You'll automatically get XP for...
[list]
[*]using tools;
[*]sleeping;
[*]eating or drinking;
[*]running out of stamina (becoming exhausted);
[*]passing out (either by working while exhausted or or staying up late).
[/list]
Get enough XP, and your endurance will level up and increase your max stamina.
